1.4.9-beta.2 (#1975)

* ✔️ Fixed freeze when playing PDF files

* ✨ UI updates

* 🎨 Color update

* 🎨 Updated General settings

* 🚩 Updated Chinese language

* Feature/quicksearch UI improvements (#1946)

* 🎨 Update QuickSearch modal to follow rounded design

- Update border-radius from 4px to 10px to match other modals
- Improve box-shadow for consistency with main popup styling
- Use primary-lighter border color for visual harmony
- Ensures QuickSearch follows the same UI design language as other modals

* ✨ Make Ctrl/Cmd+G toggle QuickSearch instead of just opening

- Change keyboard shortcut to toggle between open/close states

* Improve Comments

* feat: Add tranpose buttons to the Slide Editor (#1947)

* ✨ UI updates
- Updated languages

* feat(lyrics): Add Ultimate Guitar and re-enable all lyric providers (#1952)

This commit introduces Ultimate Guitar as a new lyric search provider

* Feature/stage editor copy paste (#1944)

* feat: add copy/paste and shift-click selection for stage editor

- Add stage_item support to copy/paste system in clipboard.ts
- Implement copyActions.stage_item to extract selected stage items
- Implement pasteActions.stage_item to paste items with new IDs and auto-select
- Add shift+click range selection for stage items in Stagebox.svelte
- Add shift+click range selection for edit items in Items.svelte and Editbox.svelte
- Maintain existing Ctrl+click multi-select functionality
- Integrate with history system for undo/redo support
- Support cross-stage copying while preserving all item settings

* fix: improve shift-click selection behavior in stage editor

- Replace range selection with simple toggle behavior
- Shift+click now adds/removes individual items from selection
- Fixes issue where shift-click would select all items unexpectedly

* revert: remove shift-click selection functionality while keeping stage item copy/paste

* Change from ctrl to shift

* fix: added support for secondary slide and fixed (#1959)

crash on single song import in VerseVIEW SongDB (XML) Importer

* ✨ Updated styles settings UI

* ✔️ Fixed select all media not working
- Fixed white secondary color contrast

* ✨ UI updates

* upgrade minor versions of npm dependencies (#1958)

* upgrade minor versions of npm dependencies

* update pdf worker

* lock sqlite3 version to 5.1.6

* update package lock

* Added error handling for dropped NDI frames and non-video data.  Issue #998

* fix choose media issue on Linux (#1965)

* ✔️ Fixed a freeze when advancing slides to an undefined one
- Fixed freeze when searching for shows
- UI updates

* 🎨 Updated drawer tabs navigation UI

* 🎨 UI updates

* Feature/remote verse highlight following  (#1970)

* feat: implement verse highlight following on remote scripture navigation

- Add activeScripture store subscription to send ACTIVE_SCRIPTURE messages to remote
- Include scriptureId in activeScripture store to identify correct scripture tab
- Add currentScriptureState store in remote to track scripture position from main app
- Add ACTIVE_SCRIPTURE receiver handler to update remote scripture state
- Update ScriptureContent to react to scripture state changes and update verse highlighting
- Fix type comparison issue by using loose equality for verse highlighting (number vs string)
- Support both API and local bible formats for chapter ID handling

Resolves issue where verse highlight would not follow when using next/previous buttons on remote show control.

* Add always-visible go back button to scripture navigation header

- Add go back button to scripture header for consistent navigation
- Button positioned on left with centered scripture title
- Always visible when viewing scripture, styled appropriately for depth
- At depth 0: dark styling, allows switching translations
- At depth > 0: normal styling, navigates back one level
- Improved UX with proper centering and layering

* Implement advanced scripture search functionality for remote interface

- Add comprehensive search capabilities matching frontend features
- Support book abbreviations (jh -> john, mt -> matthew, etc.)
- Handle multiple reference formats (colon, comma, period separators)
- Include verse content search with highlighting
- Navigate to specific verse depth when clicking search results
- Proper search clearing and result management
- Support chapter-only searches showing all verses
- Limit results display to 20 with overflow indicator
- White reference text and proper text wrapping for long search terms

* minor changed

* Revert changes from commit 3f1a520 - Remove always-visible go back button from scripture navigation header

* Revert

* remote: Scripture header and UX improvements
- Unified header with fixed back/search actions
- Added second-line reference (Book Chapter[:Verse])
- Prevented header shift and overflow; responsive title sizing
- Search view now has back button and keeps state stable
- Global scrollbar styling for RemoteShow to match main app
- A11y and typing cleanups; removed unused styles

* remote: Shows.svelte: native scrollbar on desktop; always-visible custom scrollbar on mobile; fixed track bounds and scrolling behavior

* fix up title bar

* Remote: scripture header size/centering, no-ellipsis wrap; larger touch targets for back/search; persist TabletMode left/right panel widths per browser via localStorage

* Removed accessibility errors from console and updated login UI

* cleaning up code and comments

* fix ui scrollbar in projects

* login should now be per device, updated login ui

* fix up highlighting, toggle list button, intial load

* fixing highlighting and verse bouncing

* code improvements

* Revert delay back

* added API bible support, new highlight

* highlight on reload

* Apply consistent FreeShow UI scrollbar styling to all remote components

- Added FreeShow scrollbar styling to Textarea component (fixes song editing scrollbar)
- Applied consistent scrollbar styling to Lyrics.svelte scroll area
- Added scrollbar styling to Show.svelte scroll container
- Updated AddGroups.svelte groups list with FreeShow scrollbars
- Applied scrollbar styling to GroupsEdit.svelte groups container
- Added FreeShow scrollbars to Project.svelte scroll and list areas
- Updated PdfPreview.svelte grid with consistent scrollbar styling

All scrollable areas in the remote frontend now use the unified FreeShow UI scrollbar design instead of native browser scrollbars.

* final cleanup and commit, improved search parsing

* 🔊 Audio start/end trim
- Conditions works for metadata templates
- Fixed scripture verse order sometimes broken
- Small tweaks
- Version update

---------

Co-authored-by: Auxority <35202343+Auxority@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Jeremy Zongker <jeremy@zongker.net>

account the verse splits. If you do a scripture search which includes

into account. The fix is to map the searched verses to the calculated
split verses.

* feat: Add tolerance setting for scripture verse splitting (#2801)

Adds a new 'Tolerance' setting (0-100) for scripture long verse splitting that enables smarter, punctuation-aware splits:

- When tolerance > 0, searches for punctuation marks (.,;:!?) within the tolerance window around the split point
- Splits at punctuation for more natural breaks instead of arbitrary character positions
- Auto-selects all parts of split verses when clicking (prevents accidental partial selection)
- Tolerance = 0 maintains exact original behavior (space-based splitting with rebalancing)
- Disables rebalancing when tolerance > 0 to preserve punctuation-based splits

Example: With size=160 and tolerance=20, a 192-char verse will split at the last punctuation mark between positions 140-180, rather than at an arbitrary space near position 160.

This improves readability by splitting verses at natural sentence boundaries.

Introduce index invalidation (invalidateSearchIndex) when the text cache is loaded or saved so the index is rebuilt when data changes. Extend quicksearch features and UX: category filters (all, songs, bible, media, settings), highlighted token matches, glowing placeholder indicator, snippet previews for song lyrics and Bible verses, and improved transitions/styles. Replace the category picker with hashtag-based category detection in QuickSearch and update search behavior. Key changes:
- UI: removed category bar and related styles; detect #hashtag (e.g. #shows, #audio, #overlays) and strip it from the query.
- Categories: rename 'songs' -> 'shows' and add 'audio' and 'overlays' categories; wire audio playlists/streams and overlay results into quicksearch results and triggers.
- Highlighting: prioritize exact phrase matches, then token-based highlighting (matches any word), with longer words matched first.
- Media: add option to restrict media results to audio files and set appropriate icons for audio/media.
- Bible/search index: bump behavior to support more results and finer-grained indexing (index shorter tokens, n-grams up to 5 words, search-term generation improvements) and add a Bible index version to force rebuilds when needed.

* feat: Add tolerance setting for scripture verse splitting (#2801)

Adds a new 'Tolerance' setting (0-100) for scripture long verse splitting that enables smarter, punctuation-aware splits:

- When tolerance > 0, searches for punctuation marks (.,;:!?) within the tolerance window around the split point
- Splits at punctuation for more natural breaks instead of arbitrary character positions
- Auto-selects all parts of split verses when clicking (prevents accidental partial selection)
- Tolerance = 0 maintains exact original behavior (space-based splitting with rebalancing)
- Disables rebalancing when tolerance > 0 to preserve punctuation-based splits

Example: With size=160 and tolerance=20, a 192-char verse will split at the last punctuation mark between positions 140-180, rather than at an arbitrary space near position 160.

This improves readability by splitting verses at natural sentence boundaries.

- Version update

* Updated NDI frame timing to work when videos are not 60fps

* Have basic frame rate limiter working with some issues.

* Updating timer on ndi connect/disconnect

* Stop transmitting when capture is removed

* Lowered thumbnail quality and limited rate on multiple displays

* Removed logging

* 🔁 Fixed inconsistent cloud sync
- Updated Hungarian language

* 🔁 Updated cloud sync
- You can now interact directly with the YouTube output video

* ✨ Tweaked changing to the editor
- No more notifying update if prerelease
- Tweaked next slide timer
- Fixed deleting output leaving a disabled output

* Issue 543 fix (#544)

* Fixed pasting line breaks

* Handled Mac line breaks

* ✔ Fixed Lessons videos not always downloading
- Fixed Genius lyrics search
- Trying to fix cloud sync not always working
- Quick action buttons
- Adding multiple videos will unmute them by default
- Multiple videos in one show will have the same reference

* ✨ Videos not looping will not be added as "ghost backgrounds"
- Syncing starting on startup
